title: A Vow for the Tide
author: Zephyrine Yarrow
blurb: Yara Ishikawa, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
